rule:
The test-period read for a batch sweep -- by a rule written before looking, with no judgement in it.

From ``runs/<fid>/sweep_<tag>.json`` (train / valid only) it picks, mechanically:

* ``v_base`` (the original) and ``k_known`` (the known-family benchmark), always;
* the best variant of each of the 3 best KINDS (structure / leaf / memory / shape / neutral /
  hypothesis ...), ranked by pure-long Sharpe on the user's training period, among variants that
  pass the gates (cov >= 0.95, dist >= 0.5) and whose long leg is positive on BOTH train and valid;
* the two best candidates BUILT ON the known family (overlays, screens, or any hypothesis that contains
  it) -- reported apart, because they are the known family plus a tilt or minus a screen;
* ``k_known_xfrozen``, the generic screen (known family, never the frozen-quote names), as their benchmark.

Only these are scored on the holdout (the user's test period), in the user's convention: half-life fitted on
the user's training period, pure long book net of 15 bp.  The sign of the original and of the benchmarks is the
sign of their rank IC on the user's training period (the user's rule); a picked candidate keeps the sign it was
picked under (``sign_flip`` marks the rare weak signal whose rank IC changes sign once valid is added).  The read
is ledgered.

v_base.expr: sub(div(div(day_sum(select_where(is_gt(Ret, day_quantile(Ret, 0.95)), Ret, create_like(Ret, 0))), add(day_sum(is_gt(Ret, day_quantile(Ret, 0.95))), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), 1e-06))), add(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), 1e-06))), div(div(day_sum(select_where(is_lt(Ret, day_quantile(Ret, 0.05)), abs_(Ret), create_like(Ret, 0))), add(day_sum(is_lt(Ret, day_quantile(Ret, 0.05))), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05), 1e-06))), add(abs_(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05)), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05), 1e-06))))

k_known_xfrozen.why: 已知族 + 剔除近 15 日冻结盘口最重的 20%(通用筛子基准)

h_zero_minus_liq.why: §4:秩相减把「不钉住」和「低成交额」两件事拆开,看冻结状态是不是只是低流动性的改写(解剖里 v_base 在五个成交额档段内全负)

seg_lowliq_m.expr: cs_first_low40(neg(sub(div(div(day_sum(select_where(is_gt(Ret, day_quantile(Ret, 0.95)), Ret, create_like(Ret, 0))), add(day_sum(is_gt(Ret, day_quantile(Ret, 0.95))), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), 1e-06))), add(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), 1e-06))), div(div(day_sum(select_where(is_lt(Ret, day_quantile(Ret, 0.05)), abs_(Ret), create_like(Ret, 0))), add(day_sum(is_lt(Ret, day_quantile(Ret, 0.05))), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05), 1e-06))), add(abs_(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05)), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05), 1e-06))))), cross_mean(day_sum(Amt), 30))
seg_lowliq_m.why: 只在成交额最低 40% 的股票里按本因子选

abl_M.expr: sub(div(div(day_sum(select_where(is_gt(Ret, day_quantile(Ret, 0.95)), Ret, create_like(Ret, 0))), add(day_sum(is_gt(Ret, day_quantile(Ret, 0.95))), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), 1e-06))), add(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), 1e-06))), div(div(day_sum(select_where(Ret, abs_(Ret), create_like(Ret, 0))), add(day_sum(is_lt(Ret, day_quantile(Ret, 0.05))), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05), 1e-06))), add(abs_(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05)), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05), 1e-06))))
abl_M.why: 删掉 M = is_lt,其余不变:这个节点贡献了什么

h3_xfr_zero40.why: 筛子口径的档位阶梯(新算子 cs_last_high40):剔 20% 已经把基准从 +12.6% / +22.3% 抬到 +16.4% / +23.2%。剔 40% 继续改善 = 剔的是整条低流动性尾巴(那就只是 k_known 自己的强化);到 40% 变差 = 剔的是一小撮不可交易的票,筛子有真实内容

h3_xfr_atmax.why: 本轮最硬的事实:同一个量硬筛赢软叠加 —— k_known_xfrozen(剔掉近 15 日 day_zero_ratio 最高的 20%)+16.4% / +23.2%、Lshp 2.81 / 3.98,而把同一个量做成 −0.25 权重的 overlay(h_ov_zero_m025)只有 +9.3% / +21.2%。下一步是把筛子口径做对:day_zero_ratio 混了封板 / 停牌 / 低价网格,封在当日最高价只读封顶
